marketing.text: タレントを進化させて!

reductionNotes: S1 wall backdrop (upper/lower wall, seams, strut) -> S1 main-scene; S2 talent column (rail + five nodes) -> S2 panel; S3 tooltip (header, body, flavour text, tail) plus the S4 level badge '2' docked to its header -> S3 dialog (badge merged as part of the tooltip, which is ambiguous: it is top-level in the breakdown). Marketing: M2 ledge slab (white rim, dark slate, -7.7 deg) kept as its own band because it differs from the purple band in colour and angle (rule 8), not merged as a shadow; M3 purple band -> M2 band; M4 mascot (bulbs, head, eye, fin, stalk) -> M3 cut-out; M5 headline -> M4; M1 logo -> M5 (drawn on top, z 5). Band edges from the least-squares fits: ledge y = 1822 - 0.134x, band outline y = 1966 - 0.198x (px); the ledge's bottom edge is the band's top edge. Tilted boxes are unrotated: band boxes are full-width rects placed at their mid-width heights; the headline box is solved from its measured outline bounds (1194 x 319 px at -9.7 deg -> ~1191 x 120 px). headlineGlyphPercent = measured glyph height 118 px.
